hooks.command:
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/core.md" ]; then ROOT_FILE="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/jitter-ai-agent/root"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$ROOT_FILE")" 2>/dev/null; printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" > "$ROOT_FILE" 2>/dev/null; cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/core.md"; printf '
JITTER_ROOT=%s
In a shell, set it with: JITTER_ROOT=$(cat "%s")
' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "$ROOT_FILE"; fi

if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/hardware.md" ]; then find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.kicad_pro' -print -quit | grep -q . && cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/rules/hardware.md" || true; fi

if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then find . -maxdepth 3 -name '*.kicad_pro' -print -quit | grep -q . && python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/kicad_project_check.py" 2>&1 || true; fi

if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && [ -d "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/typst" ]; then for v in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/typst/*/*/; do p=$(basename "$(dirname "$v")"); n=$(basename "$v"); d="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/typst/packages/local/$p"; [ "$(readlink "$d/$n" 2>/dev/null)" = "${v%/}" ] && [ -e "$d/$n" ] || { mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null && ln -sfn "${v%/}" "$d/$n" 2>/dev/null; }; done; fi; exit 0

MARK="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/jitter-ai-agent/onboarded"; [ -f "$MARK" ] || printf '%s\n' "First run for this person: they have not been offered the optional extras yet (commit-time checks, the shared git hook). Use the setup-extras skill early in this session, ask once, and write the marker either way."; exit 0
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/comment_lint.py" --hook; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/prose_check.py" --hook; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/guard_push.py"; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 2 ] && exit 2; fi; exit 0
